invoices.name: Invoices with every field the Bulgarian VAT Act requires
invoices.description: Art. 114 of the VAT Act is checked on issue: number, exemption basis, tax point.

credit-debit-notes.name: Credit and debit notes
credit-debit-notes.description: Always referencing the invoice, as Art. 115 of the VAT Act requires.

en16931-xml.name: Structured XML under EN 16931
en16931-xml.description: Every document is also issued as UBL 2.1 and CII — the formats of the 2028 e-invoices.

eur-vat-bg.name: VAT in euro for any currency
eur-vat-bg.description: For an invoice in dollars or francs, the base and VAT are also computed in euro at the ECB rate.

tamper-evident-ledger.name: Tamper-evident document ledger
tamper-evident-ledger.description: Every issued document sits in a sealed hash chain; any change after issue shows.

unlimited-documents.name: Unlimited documents
unlimited-documents.description: No cap on issued invoices and notes.

multi-series.name: Several number series
multi-series.description: Separate ten-digit ranges for sites or tills, with no gaps in numbering.

pdf.name: PDF for your customer
pdf.description: The readable copy, generated from the same XML, with Cyrillic and your logo.

recurring.name: Recurring invoices
recurring.description: Subscriptions and rents are issued automatically on the chosen date — one invoice per period, optionally emailed to the client.

reminders.name: Payment reminders
reminders.description: An email to the client 3 and 10 days after the due date if the invoice is unpaid — with the PDF and the balance.

bank-matching.name: Bank payment matching
bank-matching.description: Payments from the statement are linked to the invoices.

api.name: API
api.description: Issue and read documents from your own software or online shop.

roles.name: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Owner, administrator, accountant, issuer and viewer — each sees what is theirs.

audit-log.name: Audit trail
audit-log.description: Who did what and when, in a chain that cannot be rewritten.

two-factor.name: Two-factor sign-in
two-factor.description: A code from an authenticator app on every sign-in.

accountant-workspace.name: One dashboard for every client company
accountant-workspace.description: The firm sees and issues for each company from one place, without separate accounts.

mandates.name: Authorisations under Art. 113(7) of the VAT Act
mandates.description: Every document the firm issues carries the authorisation it was issued under.

peppol.name: Sending and receiving over the e-invoicing network
peppol.description: Over the Peppol network (AS4); we will check conformity with the regulation under the 2028 bill once it is published.

nra-reporting.name: Reporting to the National Revenue Agency
nra-reporting.description: Data for every document sent to the NRA system once the ordinance is out.

saf-t.name: Data for SAF-T
saf-t.description: Your invoices in the accounting Standard Audit File.

priority-support.name: Priority support
priority-support.description: An answer within the working day.

inbox.name: Inbox between Fakturist companies
inbox.description: An invoice to a company registered with us lands in its inbox on its own, with an email carrying the PDF and XML.

proforma.name: Pro forma invoices
proforma.description: A payment request with its own numbering, PDF and sending by email; “Issue invoice” turns it into an invoice.
